58/G.goal: Explain how VR rendering maps 3D scenes to displayed pixels and how the graphics pipeline, graphics APIs, layered software, and parallel GPUs influence its computational resource requirements.
58/G.achieves: Prepares the learner to analyze the resource demands of an XR system and later support its optimization and confident implementation.

58/O1.goal: Describe how the 3D graphics pipeline transforms scene geometry into a pixel grid and why scan conversion, aliasing, and realistic dynamic VR content increase rendering computational complexity.
58/O1.achieves: Enables the learner to identify where rendering resource demands arise in an XR system before analyzing optimization strategies.

58/O2.goal: Explain how graphics APIs and layered VR software allow applications to use parallel GPUs to execute graphics pipeline stages efficiently.
58/O2.achieves: Gives the learner a map of the VR software and hardware stack needed to reason about resource requirements in XR development.
